suite_note: Both suites have 60 cases and 106 decisions; the public regression wording differs and its end-to-end results are separate.

method.best_thread_selection: Core i7 and Apple: lowest 1-question median among ten-repeat pilots. Ryzen: fixed eight threads from the completed independent single-question sweep; no new pilots. All workloads measured at selected count.
method.cold_load: New process/session; filesystem caches not flushed. Imports and first answer recorded separately.
method.fresh_total: Core i7 only, one actual fresh-folder run per backend: install, download, conversion when needed, imports/load and the same fixed two-question first request. UV binary preparation and source transfer excluded; this is not a setup-time distribution.
method.memory: Sampled process RSS every 0.1 seconds; MiB.
method.background_load: Other applications left running. Baseline and estimated concurrent other CPU activity recorded; shared-machine load limits comparisons.
method.quantization: Stale value_info stripped. Per-channel and mixed use reduce_range=True on Core i7-10700KF (7-bit range in INT8 storage); Additional variant work stopped on Apple and Ryzen; completed Core i7 policies are recorded. Mixed uses an explicit encoder MatMul/Gemm whitelist, leaving embeddings and decision path FP32.
